description: Registry rows the fixtures use. engine, severities and confirm_class are copied from rule-facts.md. The templates are fixture inputs: the spec requires fixed per-rule host templates filled with the subject but gives no text. A fixture's host.json overrides confirm_class.

compat.default-changed.summary_template: The default of {subject} changed, so a caller that does not set it gets different resources.
compat.default-changed.suggested_fix_template: Restore the base default of {subject}, or declare the change as breaking with an upgrade note.

compat.type-narrowed.summary_template: The type of {subject} is narrower than at the base, so a value that was valid before is rejected.
compat.type-narrowed.suggested_fix_template: Restore the base type of {subject}, or declare the change as breaking with an upgrade note.

compat.variable-now-required.summary_template: {subject} is now required, so a caller that does not set it fails to plan.
compat.variable-now-required.suggested_fix_template: Restore a default for {subject}, or declare the change as breaking with an upgrade note.

compat.variable-removed.summary_template: {subject} is removed, so a caller that sets it fails to plan.
compat.variable-removed.suggested_fix_template: Restore {subject} with its base type and default, or declare the change as breaking with an upgrade note.

coverage.unknown-argument.summary_template: {subject} is not an argument in the provider schema, so the block fails to plan.
coverage.unknown-argument.suggested_fix_template: Remove {subject}, or use the argument name the provider schema has.

examples.stale-reference.summary_template: The example refers to {subject}, which the module no longer has, so the example cannot initialize.
examples.stale-reference.suggested_fix_template: Update the example to the module's current interface in place of {subject}.

review.check-not-run.summary_template: Rule {rule_id} was not decided for {subject}: the model reply was still invalid after the repair turn.

scope.module-call.summary_template: {subject} calls another module from inside the module.
scope.module-call.suggested_fix_template: Remove {subject}, or move the composition to the caller.

structure.argument-order.summary_template: {subject} does not follow the profile's argument order.
structure.argument-order.suggested_fix_template: Move the meta-arguments of {subject} to the positions the profile gives.

structure.arn-partition-hardcoded.summary_template: {subject} hardcodes the aws partition in an ARN.
structure.arn-partition-hardcoded.suggested_fix_template: Build the ARN in {subject} with local.partition.

structure.output-no-try.summary_template: {subject} indexes a conditional resource without try, so it fails when the resource is not created.
structure.output-no-try.suggested_fix_template: Wrap the value of {subject} in try(..., null).

structure.wrong-file.summary_template: {subject} is not in the file the profile gives for its kind of block.
structure.wrong-file.suggested_fix_template: Move {subject} to the file the profile gives.
